name: Ferienwohnungen Lederer
beschreibung:
Idylllically and sunnily situated in Soell, the Lederer family welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean warmth in comfortable apartments featuring balconies with alpine views.

The Soell cable car base station to the SkiWelt and summer hiking trails are right nearby.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnungen Lederer in Soell offers family comfort at the foot of the Wilder Kaiser.
